subject: Operational cadence update — priority pivot and role refresh for Q4 planning
messages:
From: rishi_malhotra
To: jonas_weber, lauren_bishop, priyom_das
Cc: Kelly Monroe <kelly@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Operational cadence update — priority pivot and role refresh for Q4 planning

Team,

We're entering a compressed QBR window and I want to put a short, decision-oriented note on the table so we can align the org before exec reviews. TL;DR: recommend shifting two short-term priorities into the Q4 backlog (Latency SLO sprint and SDK stability epic), consolidate two small squads, and refresh three role scopes to reduce handoffs and speed execution.

Why now:
- Latency SLO work will materially reduce infra costs for our Dedicated customers and is a clear signal for renewals.
- SDK stability has regressed after the multi-model rollout; it’s chewing support cycles.
- Several squads have overlapping operating surfaces (prefix caching, routing policy hooks). Consolidation reduces context switching.

What I'm proposing (details in attached deck and doc):
1) Move 'Feature X: latency micro-optimizations' from mid-term to Q4 sprint A (2-week focused push).
2) Pause a low-adoption experimental feature and reassign one IC from that team to SDK stability.
3) Merge the 'routing-policy' pod into 'serving-core' under a single lead for 8 weeks, with a temporary role refresh for the routing lead to become 'serving-core integrator (interim)'.
4) Headcount asks: +0 FTE this quarter — we reallocate existing capacity. Hiring for permanent roles to be prioritized in the Q1 plan.

Open asks for this thread:
- Jonas: quick check on OKR impact and whether moving Latency SLO to Q4 jeopardizes any partner commitments.
- Lauren: if you agree with the temporary reorg, can you help draft the comms and confirm the people manager notifications cadence?
- Priyom: can you surface any procurement/contract implications (esp. for Dedicated customers) and confirm there are no billing side effects?

Attachments: Q4_priority_pivot_v1.pdf, role-refresh-rationale.docx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3CqQ4-priority-pivot

I know this is short notice — my goal is to lock a final proposal by EOD Wednesday so that the exec readout has a clear ask. If we can't get to final, we'll present options and call out risks.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
VP Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber
To: rishi_malhotra
Cc: lauren_bishop, priyom_das, Kelly Monroe <kelly@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2027 11:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational cadence update — priority pivot and role refresh for Q4 planning

Rishi —

Appreciate the note and the deck. Two quick points after a read-through:

1) OKR consideration: the Latency SLO work maps to OKR-Infra-1 (reduce avg p95 by 12%). If we move it to Q4 sprint A we will still hit the objective provided we reserve the 3-week stabilization buffer in sprint B. I recommend we keep a measurables row in the comms with the stabilization buffer callout.

2) Partner commitments: I pinged Kelly; there's one Dedicated customer (Acme Analytics) with an open roadmap ask tied to the routing policy hooks. If we merge routing into serving-core, we need to add a partner-facing compatibility note and schedule a two-week partner review. That shouldn't block the sprint but must be in the rollout plan.

Minor: can we make the temporary role title explicitly timeboxed (e.g., 'integrator (12 weeks)') to reduce ambiguity?

I'll sketch the OKR language and add a short table of affected success metrics — uploading to the Drive link you shared.

— Jonas
Director of Product
From: lauren_bishop
To: rishi_malhotra, jonas_weber
Cc: priyom_das
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2027 14:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational cadence update — priority pivot and role refresh for Q4 planning

Sounds reasonable. A couple of operational asks before we finalize:

- Manager notifications: I'd like a staggered notification cadence — notify impacted managers 48 hours before the all-hands comms, then 24 hours later send a consolidated FAQ to ICs. I'll take point on the comms draft and will propose the FAQ.
- Headcount reallocation: we should flag the change in the hiring backlog so recruiters don't double-source candidates. Priyom, please add a hiring freeze note for impacted reqs.

Also agree with Jonas — timebox the interim title and add an explicit list of deliverables for the 8–12 week window so we can measure the merge success.

I'll attach the comms cadence template we used in June.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
VP People Operations
From: priyom_das
To: rishi_malhotra, lauren_bishop, jonas_weber
Cc: Kelly Monroe <kelly@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational cadence update — priority pivot and role refresh for Q4 planning

Quick procurement and hiring notes:

- Procurement: no contract changes expected for Dedicated customers if we're only adjusting internal delivery sequences. I'll notify account operations to add a compatibility note for Acme Analytics and schedule a partner review with Kelly the week of Nov 22.
- Billing: no impact to current invoices or commitments. Any additional scope that the partner requests during the review would be handled as change control.
- Hiring: I added a temporary hold on reqs 3421 and 3478; recruiters notified. We can lift the hold with a single email when leadership signs off.

Attached: QBR_prep_checklist.xlsx — I added a line item to ensure partner communications are slotted into the QBR readout.

— Priyom
Head of Program Management
From: rishi_malhotra
To: lauren_bishop, jonas_weber, priyom_das
Cc: Kelly Monroe <kelly@acmeanalytics.com>, Acme Talent <talent@acmetalent.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 16:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational cadence update — priority pivot and role refresh for Q4 planning

Thanks all — summary and decisions:   

1) Approve: Move Latency SLO micro-optimizations to Q4 sprint A with a 3-week stabilization buffer in sprint B. (Owner: Infrastructure Eng lead).
2) Approve: Reassign one IC from experimental feature to SDK stability for the quarter. No headcount add. Recruiters paused on the impacted reqs. (Owner: Product Eng Managers).
3) Approve (timeboxed): Merge routing-policy into serving-core with interim title 'Serving-Core Integrator (12 weeks)'. Deliverables: compatibility checklist, partner review, and automated test coverage baseline. (Owner: Jonas).
4) Partner outreach: Priyom to schedule partner review with Kelly — target Nov 22. Kelly: please let us know any timing constraints.

Next steps:
- Lauren to finalize comms cadence and draft the all-hands announcement by Monday, Nov 15.
- Jonas to add the OKR measurable rows to the Drive doc by EOD Nov 10 (uploaded).
- Priyom to confirm partner review slot and update the QBR checklist (done).

I'll take the exec readout version and circulate it to the execs on Friday morning. If there are any objections, flag them in-thread by EOD tomorrow.

Rishi
VP Product Operations
Redwood Inference
